sections.title: 1. Your agreement with Hayame
paragraphs: Hayame is an online marketplace, operated by Hayame Technologies in Ghana, where car owners (hosts) list vehicles and other people (renters) book them. These terms are a binding agreement between you and Hayame. By tapping Accept, creating an account, listing a car or booking a trip, you agree to them, together with our Privacy Policy, Cancellation Policy and Protection information.
If you do not agree, you may not use Hayame. If you use Hayame for a company or another organisation, you confirm that you are allowed to accept these terms on its behalf.

sections.title: 2. Who can use Hayame
paragraphs: You must be at least 18 years old and legally able to enter into a contract. To rent a car you must also hold a valid, unexpired driving licence that allows you to drive that type of vehicle in Ghana, and you must not be disqualified from driving.
We may refuse, suspend or close any account, and decline any booking, where we believe there is a safety, fraud or legal risk.

sections.title: 3. Your account and identity checks
paragraphs: The information you give us must be true, current and your own. You may hold one account only, and you must keep your password and phone secure. You are responsible for everything done through your account.

Before your first booking we ask for a photo of your face and photos of the front and back of your driving licence, and we must approve them before you can pay for a trip. Hosts are verified with a government-issued ID. Submitting documents that are false, altered, expired or belong to someone else is a serious breach of these terms and may be reported to the police.
You agree that we may check your details, ask for more information at any time, and repeat these checks when a licence expires or something about your account changes.

sections.title: 4. How bookings work
paragraphs: When a booking is confirmed, the rental agreement is between the renter and the host. Hayame is not a car rental company, does not own the vehicles and is not a party to that agreement. We provide the platform, collect payment, and help both sides when something goes wrong.

A booking is confirmed when it is paid and, unless the listing offers instant booking, accepted by the host. If the host declines or does not respond in time, the renter is refunded in full. Dates, pick-up or delivery details, the area where the car will be driven and the price shown at checkout form part of the booking.

sections.title: 5. Only you may drive: no renting for someone else
paragraphs: The person who books is the person who drives. You may not book a car on behalf of another person, and you may not rent, lend, hand over, sub-let or otherwise pass the car to anyone else, whether or not they pay you.

Nobody else may drive the car unless the host has agreed to that named person in the Hayame chat before they drive, and that person holds their own verified Hayame account and a valid driving licence. You remain fully responsible for the car and for anything an additional driver does.

The host must hand the keys only to the verified renter shown on the booking, after checking that the person and their driving licence match. If someone else arrives, the host should refuse the handover and tell Hayame.
Where a listing comes with a driver, only the host's driver may drive, and the renter may not take the wheel.

If a car is found being driven by an unauthorised person, the trip may be ended immediately without refund, the car may be recovered at the renter's cost, any protection may not apply, and the renter is liable for all resulting loss.

sections.title: 6. Payments, fees and the deposit
paragraphs: Prices are in Ghana cedis (GHS). Payment is taken at checkout through our payment partner, Paystack, by mobile money, card or bank transfer. The total shown before you pay includes the rental price, the Hayame service fee and, where they apply, insurance, delivery, an outside-region surcharge and a refundable deposit.

The deposit is returned after the trip, less any amounts owed under these terms, for example for damage, missing fuel, late return, cleaning, traffic fines, tolls or towing. If the deposit does not cover what is owed, you agree to pay the balance when we ask for it.
All payments for a trip must be made through Hayame. Hosts are paid for completed trips after Hayame's fee is deducted. You are responsible for any taxes that apply to the money you earn or pay.

sections.title: 7. Cancellations and refunds
paragraphs: Each listing shows its cancellation policy (flexible, moderate or strict). If a renter cancels, the refund follows that policy and depends on how close to pick-up the cancellation is made. If a host cancels a confirmed booking, the renter is refunded in full and the host may be charged a fee or removed from Hayame for repeated cancellations.

If the renter does not arrive, arrives without their valid driving licence, or is not the verified person on the booking, the host may refuse the handover and the booking is treated as a late cancellation by the renter. Refunds go back to the original payment method and may take several working days to appear.

sections.title: 8. How the car may be used
paragraphs: You must drive carefully, obey the road traffic laws of Ghana, wear seat belts, and carry no more passengers than the car has seats. The car must stay within the area stated in the booking; trips outside the listing's region carry the surcharge shown at checkout and must be declared when you book.

You must not use or allow the car to be used: (a) by anyone under the influence of alcohol or drugs; (b) for any unlawful purpose; (c) as a taxi, for ride-hailing, deliveries or to carry passengers or goods for payment, unless the host has agreed in the Hayame chat; (d) for racing, speed testing, driving lessons, off-road driving or on roads not suitable for the car; (e) to tow or push anything; (f) to carry dangerous, illegal or strongly smelling goods; (g) outside Ghana; or (h) in any way that overloads or damages it.

You must not smoke in the car, carry animals without the host's agreement, remove or tamper with any tracker, odometer, number plate or other part, make repairs or changes without the host's agreement, or leave the car unlocked or with the keys inside.

sections.title: 9. Pick-up, return, fuel and condition
paragraphs: At pick-up and at return, both renter and host should inspect the car together and take clear, dated photos of its outside, inside, fuel level and mileage. These photos are the main evidence if there is a disagreement, so a party who takes none may find it hard to prove their case.

The renter must return the car on time, to the agreed place, in the same condition (allowing for normal wear), reasonably clean and with the same amount of fuel. To keep the car longer you must ask for and receive an extension through Hayame before the booking ends. Keeping a car past the end of the booking without agreement is a serious breach: late fees apply, any protection may stop, and the car may be reported to the police as taken without consent.
The host must provide the car on time, clean, roadworthy, with enough fuel to reach a filling station, and as described in the listing.

sections.title: 10. Accidents, damage, theft and breakdowns
paragraphs: From handover until the car is returned to the host, the renter is responsible for it. If there is an accident, damage, theft, fire or breakdown, you must make sure everyone is safe, then immediately tell the host and Hayame through the app, and report to the Ghana Police Service where the law requires it or where anyone is injured, another vehicle or property is involved, or the car is stolen. You must obtain a police report and give us and the host every reasonable help, including statements and photos.

Do not admit fault to others, abandon the car or arrange repairs yourself. The renter is liable for loss of or damage to the car during the trip, for the cost of recovery and towing, and for the host's reasonable loss of income while the car is repaired, except to the extent the loss is paid by insurance or was caused by the host or a fault that existed before the trip.

sections.title: 11. Fines, tolls and other charges
paragraphs: The renter must pay all tolls, parking charges, traffic fines, penalties, towing and impound fees incurred during the trip, including those that arrive after the trip has ended. If the host or Hayame pays any of these, the renter must repay them together with any reasonable administration cost.

sections.title: 12. Insurance and protection
paragraphs: Hayame is not an insurance company. Any cover on a trip is the insurance the host holds on the vehicle, together with any insurance or protection item shown at checkout, and is subject to the terms, limits and exclusions of that policy. Cover may not apply where these terms are broken, for example where an unauthorised person drives or the car is used in a prohibited way, and the renter then bears the full loss.
Hosts must keep valid motor insurance that permits the vehicle to be hired out, and are responsible for confirming this with their insurer.

sections.title: 13. If you are a host
paragraphs: You confirm that you own each car you list or have the owner's written permission to hire it out, and that it is registered with the DVLA, has a valid roadworthiness certificate and insurance, is safe, well maintained and free of any recall or defect you know about.

Your listing, photos, price, features and availability must be accurate and kept up to date. You must honour confirmed bookings, respond to requests promptly, hand over only to the verified renter, and treat renters fairly and without unlawful discrimination. You are responsible for your own car and for meeting any licensing, tax and legal duties that apply to hiring it out.

sections.title: 14. Keep it on Hayame
paragraphs: You may not ask for or accept payment outside Hayame for a trip found on Hayame, or use Hayame to find people and then arrange the rental privately. Off-platform arrangements have no protection, no deposit handling and no support from us, and may lead to your account being closed.

sections.title: 15. Respect, messages and reviews
paragraphs: Treat other users with respect. You may not harass, threaten, deceive or discriminate against anyone, post false or misleading content, or use Hayame to send spam. Reviews must be honest and based on a real trip. We may review messages and trip records to investigate a report, resolve a dispute or keep users safe, and we may remove content that breaks these terms.

sections.title: 16. Vehicle tracking and your data
paragraphs: Vehicles on Hayame may be fitted with GPS or other tracking devices, and you agree that the host and Hayame may use them during a trip to locate and recover the car and to investigate a breach of these terms. We handle personal data, including your identity documents, as described in our Privacy Policy and in line with Ghana's Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843).

sections.title: 17. Suspension and ending this agreement
paragraphs: You may stop using Hayame and ask us to close your account at any time, once you have no active trips or amounts owing. We may suspend or close your account, cancel bookings or remove listings if you break these terms, fail a verification check, put others at risk, or where the law requires it. Amounts you owe, and terms that by their nature should continue, remain in force after your account is closed.

sections.title: 18. Hayame's responsibility
paragraphs: We work to keep Hayame safe and reliable, but we do not own, inspect or control the vehicles, and we do not guarantee the conduct of any host or renter, the condition or legality of any car, or that the service will always be available or free of errors. You use Hayame and any vehicle at your own risk.

To the fullest extent the law allows, Hayame is not liable for indirect or consequential loss, loss of profit or loss of data, and our total liability to you for any claim connected with a booking is limited to the Hayame service fee paid on that booking. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot lawfully be limited, including for death or personal injury caused by our negligence, or for fraud.
You agree to compensate Hayame for losses and reasonable costs we suffer because you broke these terms or the law, or because of how you used a vehicle.

sections.title: 19. Disputes and governing law
paragraphs: If something goes wrong, contact the other party through the Hayame chat first, and report the problem to us in the app within 24 hours of the trip ending so we can help. You agree to give us the photos and information we reasonably ask for, and that we may decide how a deposit is applied based on the evidence both sides provide.

These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Ghana. We and you will first try to settle any dispute by negotiation, and may agree to mediation under the Alternative Dispute Resolution Act, 2010 (Act 798). Otherwise the courts of Ghana have jurisdiction.

sections.title: 20. Changes to these terms
paragraphs: We may update these terms as Hayame grows or the law changes. When we make an important change we will show you the new terms in the app and ask you to accept them before you continue. A booking is governed by the terms in force when it was made.

sections.title: 21. Contact us
paragraphs: Questions about these terms can be sent to support@hayamegh.com or through Help in the app. Hayame Technologies, Accra Digital Centre, Ring Road West, Accra, Ghana.
